facts.text: Jolene taught herself how to play video games, with her dad providing support and her mom playing games with her.

evidence.quote: I taught myself, but my dad was always supportive and my mom would play games with me.
When I was 10, my parents got me that and it was the start of my passion for video games.

facts.text: Jolene's favorite video game to play with her mom was 'Monster Hunter: World'.

evidence.quote: One of my favorites was 'Monster Hunter: World'. The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!
